text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer. Long time no see!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Just normal. I only went to a 
relative's house for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I went over to visit my aunt. We caught 
up, chatted about this and that—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'll give you the souvenir later. I-I 
mean, you take care of me and all... so 
it's just common courtesy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! We made cookies together too. 
Look forward to having some later.
